							has_mission = jxp_a_buddhist_woodblocks_scriptures
							has_mission = jxp_a_buddhist_korean_scriptures

					}
				}
				# toyotomi
				AND = {
					jxp_a_105_profile_toyotomi_trigger = yes

						}
					}
				}
				# commercial_council
				AND = {
					jxp_a_105_profile_commercial_council_trigger = yes
					has_mission = jxp_mission_shrine_land_registers
					has_mission = jxp_mission_uncommitted_watch_the_four_seas

							has_mission = jxp_mission_sakoku_coastal_magistrates
							has_mission = jxp_mission_eastasia_ryukyu_gateway
							has_mission = jxp_mission_pacific_charter
